name: Monika Hicks, LCSW
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker and Mental Health Consultant
bio: Monika Hicks, LCSW is a licensed clinical social worker and mental health consultant who leads Hicks Consulting. She supports individuals through virtual therapy, coaching, and groups while helping organizations address burnout, trauma exposure, emotional sustainability, boundaries, workplace wellbeing, and healthier people systems through trainings, workshops, and keynote speaking.
serviceArea: Virtual therapy for eligible Tennessee clients, including Memphis
